title: Fluid painting
author: Pavel Dobryakov
description: Stir ribbons of colour into a slow-moving current.
instructions: Drag to paint. Space pauses the flow.

title: A pool of light
author: Evan Wallace
description: Ripples, reflections and a sphere you can move through water.
instructions: Drag the water or sphere. Space pauses.

title: Sandspiel
author: Max Bittker
description: Paint a tiny world with sand, water, plants and fire.
instructions: Choose a material, then draw in the sandbox.

title: Orb Farm
author: Max Bittker
description: Build a sealed ecosystem in a glass jar.
instructions: Add water, plants and life. Let the jar settle.

title: Fluid experiment
author: George Corney
description: Push light and smoke through a flowing field.
instructions: Move or drag across the field.

title: Harmony
author: Mr.doob
description: A sketchbook of procedural brushes and unexpected lines.
instructions: Choose a brush, then draw.

title: Fireflies
author: Nicky Case
description: Watch a field of individual lights learn to pulse together.
instructions: Tap fireflies and change how they influence each other.

title: A thousand birds
author: three.js contributors
description: A flock of paper-like birds follows simple rules. Move through it.
instructions: Move the pointer to steer the flock.

title: LOOPY
author: Nicky Case
description: Draw a system. Set it in motion. See what comes back.
instructions: Draw circles and arrows, then press Play.

title: Field Play
author: Andrei Kashcha
description: Explore flowing particles and the mathematics beneath them.
instructions: Drag to explore; change the field in its controls.

title: A growing tree
author: Andrei Kashcha
description: Branching patterns emerge from a few simple rules.
instructions: Adjust the controls and watch the tree grow.

title: A tiny driving world
author: Bruno Simon
description: Drive a little car through a playful three-dimensional world.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD. Best on a laptop.

title: Particle Life
author: Hunar Ahmad
description: Simple attractions produce surprisingly lifelike movement.
instructions: Change the rules or randomize the particles.

title: Lenia
author: Bert Wang-Chak Chan
description: Explore a continuous world of mathematical life forms.
instructions: Choose a creature and explore its changing patterns.

title: HexGL
author: Thibaut Despoulain
description: A brief, fast flight through a futuristic racing course.
instructions: Start a race. Use arrow keys to steer.

title: The Evolution of Trust
author: Nicky Case
description: A playable exploration of cooperation and trust.
instructions: Make choices and see how the players respond.

title: Parable of the Polygons
author: Vi Hart & Nicky Case
description: Move a few shapes. Watch small choices change a whole world.
instructions: Drag unhappy shapes to a new neighbourhood.

title: The Wisdom of Crowds
author: Nicky Case
description: Build connections and see an idea spread.
instructions: Follow the prompts and draw connections.

title: Streamlines
author: Andrei Kashcha
description: Trace the shape of an invisible field.
instructions: Explore the field and its settings.

title: Voxel painter
author: three.js contributors
description: Build a small sculpture one block at a time.
instructions: Click to add a block. Shift-click removes it.
